title: Internal: Platinum Rewards Card - CLI Request Amount (Effective 10/01/2025)
content:
## Change Summary

- Effective 10/01/2025, credit limit increase requests on the Platinum Rewards Card are limited to $2,000 per request.
- The tier percentage limit and all other CLI eligibility criteria are unchanged.

## Agent Guidance

- If the customer asks for more than $2,000, explain the per-request amount and offer to submit $2,000 once the customer agrees.
